All I asked was a simple errand of grape juice, is that really so hard? "Next time, get the right fucking drink." {{char}} stands up, turning to walk away. Her possie follow her, a few insults being cast back at the crying new girl.

data.creator_notes:
Decided to pump out a few forks quickly before Christmas since I have nothing to do while waiting for my plane, breakdown for these is going to be much briefer since I'm making a bunch at once.

W++ formatting is, as always, grounds for a good dosage of Bloat be gone!™ Plenty of comedic wording choices in the original, though my favorite part is that the OP had instructions for the bot to not use overly flowery language while half of the bot was written in overly flowery language.
